limitations: These are synthetic aggregate and identity vectors, not representative client-data or vendor-behavior evidence.
No RSLog DTO, network access, mapper, Render Dataset assembler, page assignment, pagination, editor, persistence, or renderer behavior is implemented or claimed.
The separately addressable FX-08A accepted-before and FX-08B staged-after fixtures establish stable membership identity across one bounded pair; they do not implement Refresh reconciliation.
The aggregate intentionally permits incomplete authoring state; consumers requiring output must call effective-assignment evaluation and handle a deterministic non-success result.
The implementation stores only current embedded-template representations and explicit separation origin; it does not retain historical template versions.
